positive_cases.prompt: 审计多中心增强 CT radiomics 输入：各院静脉期、层厚和重建核不同，还有多个重建序列可选。
规划跨 1.5T/3T 的 DWI/ADC 定量研究，明确 b 值、ADC 生成、畸变、体模和外部中心验证。
审计多中心脑肿瘤 MRS/MRSI 代谢物研究，作者把拟合浓度当作直接化学测量，并只报告最好的体素。
required_checks: linewidth SNR residual and fit uncertainty

positive_cases.prompt: 规划任务态与静息态 BOLD fMRI 研究，冻结任务执行、运动生理混杂、预处理、ROI 和多重性边界。
解释跨扫描仪 DTI 与 tractography 结果，检查梯度方向、畸变校正、模型和追踪参数，避免把 streamline 当作轴突。
required_checks: tracking seed ROI stopping and threshold parameters

positive_cases.prompt: 解释 FDG PET/CT 治疗前后 SUV 变化；两次扫描摄取时间、血糖和重建版本不同。
审阅定量 SPECT/CT 研究，检查准直器、能窗、角度采样、校正、重建和系统校准是否支持绝对活度结论。
像导师一样教我设计多操作者剪切波弹性成像研究，避免只保存最好的一张图。
required_checks: ROI depth quality map and units

positive_cases.prompt: 冻结便携胸片 AI 研究的采集 Methods，保留 AP/PA、体位、曝光、后处理版本和设备迁移边界。
设计 FFDM、DBT 和 synthetic 2D 比较研究，锁定视图、压迫、剂量、重建和既往片可用性。
外部中心使用从未见过的扫描仪和协议，作者想用整个外部集重新 harmonize 后仍称独立外部验证。
PET/CT 的 CT 同时用于衰减校正和病灶形态定量，请审计两条测量链。

boundary_cases.prompt: 把 DICOM 标签和像素里的身份信息去掉并准备公开共享。
决定这个肝癌队列应该用哪个当前诊断标准和治疗反应规则。
设计两名放射科医生勾画 ROI、复测和仲裁的 SOP。
根据已经冻结的 CT 输入运行 PyRadiomics 并选择 bin width。
训练低剂量 CT 重建网络并调学习率和 checkpoint。
判断三种重建核谁显著更好并计算配对置信区间。
设计放射科医生有无 AI 辅助的 MRMC 阅片者研究。
解释 ADC 与免疫细胞状态之间的机制并设计病理验证。
替这位具体患者决定要不要增强扫描以及辐射剂量。
把普通 X 线或 CT 的 QC 规则直接套到 DSA、透视、锥形束 CT 和介入影像，并宣称程序与剂量合格。

invariants: The measurement object and intended claim precede parameter recommendations
Patient examination series reconstruction frame and voxel levels remain distinct
Series phase sequence view tracer and reconstruction selection is fixed before outcome or model-performance review
Acquisition reconstruction post-processing and display are separate provenance stages
A series description or filename does not verify acquisition parameters
A standardized protocol does not prove cross-platform equivalence
Derived maps and model outputs are not automatically direct physical measurements
MRS and MRSI require a conditionally loaded spectroscopy contract and fitted outputs are not direct chemical assays
BOLD fMRI requires a conditionally loaded functional contract and is not direct neuronal activity or causal proof
DTI and tractography require a conditionally loaded diffusion contract and streamlines are not axons or proven connections
Fluoroscopy DSA angiography cone-beam CT and interventional imaging require a local extension and cannot borrow ordinary CT or projection-radiography assurance
Phantom repeatability does not establish clinical validity
Test-retest change is compared with a prespecified measurement-error scale
Wholly unseen scanner and protocol levels remain distinct from represented levels
External-data harmonisation or recalibration is labelled adaptation and does not retain an untouched external claim
Harmonisation cannot repair missing acquisition metadata or complete site-outcome confounding
Quantitative units formulas corrections and reference objects remain explicit
Nondiagnostic and failed acquisitions remain visible rather than being silently excluded
Eligible acquired exported accepted nondiagnostic and excluded denominators remain explicit and reason-reconciled at each declared grain
Current standards and profiles require exact version applicability and live source verification
Individual patient acquisition contrast radiation and treatment decisions remain with qualified responsible clinicians
